sloka: जनकः प्रांजलिः वाक्यम् उवाच कुशिकाअत्मजम् ।धन्यो अस्मि अनुगृहीतो अस्मि यस्य मे मुनिपुंगव ॥१-६५-३१॥
transliteration: janakaḥ prāṁjaliḥ vākyam uvāca kuśikāatmajam ।dhanyo asmi anugṛhīto asmi yasya me munipuṁgava ॥1-65-31॥

translations.english: "O Righteous one O Preeminent among ascetics you have come to my sacrifice accompanied by the descendants of Kakustha (Rama and Lakshmana). I am blessed by your presence and am highly favoured.
